products.name: Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones
products.description: Industry leading noise cancellation with two processors and 8 microphones. Ultra comfortable lightweight design with soft fit leather and up to 30 hours of battery life with quick charging.

Magnificent sound engineered with High-Resolution Audio support

reviews.author: Marcus Vance
reviews.title: Unbelievable noise cancelling & acoustic depth
reviews.comment: These are hands-down the best travel and work headphones I've ever owned. The noise cancelling removes all subway drone and office chatter effortlessly. Battery easily lasts the whole work week.

reviews.author: Sarah Jenkins
reviews.title: Super lightweight and comfortable for long sessions
reviews.comment: I wear these 7-8 hours a day for meetings and coding. Unlike previous models, these don't put any pressure on the crown of the head. Soundstage is crisp and immersive.

reviews.author: David Chen
reviews.title: Great sound, wish the case folded smaller
reviews.comment: Sound quality and call clarity are a solid 10/10. The only minor gripe is the case is slightly larger than the XM4 because the earcups rotate flat but don't fold inward.
